task_as_i_read_it.description: the task as you read it, in your own words, one or two sentences, written before the work. The manager compares it with what was sent, so a misreading shows here.

narrowest_reading.description: only if the task was ambiguous: the narrowest reading you took, and what the other reading would have been. Empty if it was not ambiguous.

followups.description: work you found that mattered and did not do, one line each. Empty if there is none.

found.description: false if what was asked for is not there
